title: Onsite Calibration of the Shear-Shear Correlation
efc_relevance: HSC PDR3 Fourier-Quad onsite calibration finds S8 = 0.740 ± 0.030, lower than EFC's robust P4 value near 0.82. Shear-bias dependence on photo-z bin, S/N cut, band, and estimator makes this a limitation on the robustness of the cross-survey S8 picture until a matched systematics study is performed, not a direct P4 falsification.
ledger_action: Add to §4b as external evidence; update P4 with a limitation note. Do not add to the EFC evidence register or change the sealed P4 threshold.
